existing_features.title: Change the admin “User Accounts” list so that an account only appears after the user has placed their first order (i.e., hide user profiles that have zero orders).
Fix the “Give admin access / Grant Admin Access” control so the owner (traviscastonguay@gmail.com) can type into the email input and successfully grant admin access.
Add admin account actions to support banning/unbanning a user account, and enforce bans by blocking banned users from creating new orders.

Ensure admins can make edits to orders and accounts from the admin panel, including: order status updates, tracking number updates, order deletion (existing), plus account actions (VIP toggle existing + ban/unban newly added).
